concerns.text: FR-002 (10s epochs) is covered by T014a (update spec) and T014 (decision doc), but T014a creates a circular dependency: tasks cannot update the spec (the source of truth) before the spec is ratified. The spec already states 10s epochs in v1.1; T014a is a stale task attempting to fix a spec that is already correct, creating a logical deadlock for the 'Foundational' phase.

FR-004 (Power Analysis) and SC-002 (Simulation) are covered by T027, but T027b (Halt Check) and T023 (Correlation Implementation) are marked [X] (complete) while the Plan explicitly states the pipeline is 'BLOCKED' on cognitive data. The tasks assume a data state (cognitive scores available) that the Plan and Constitution (Principle VII) confirm does not exist, leaving the implementation of the 'blocked' path unverified and the 'skip' logic (T023a) potentially untested against the actual data state.

FR-008 (Sensitivity Analysis) requires a summary report (SC-003). T018a and T018b generate raw reports, but T018c (Aggregate/Validate Sensitivity) is marked [ ] (unexecuted). Without T018c, the 'Sensitivity Summary' artifact is missing, leaving SC-003 unfulfilled and the FR-008 requirement only partially implemented.

FR-006 (Reproducibility/trace_id) requires injecting trace_id into final CSVs. T019 and T028 are marked [ ] (unexecuted) and depend on T008_run and T023_run, which are also [ ] (unexecuted). The tasks to produce the final artifacts (the CSVs) are missing execution steps, meaning the trace_id injection cannot be verified or performed.

Task T005 and T023 contain comments `<!-- FAILED: unspecified -->`. These are stale markers from a previous iteration indicating incomplete logic. While the logic is described in the text, the presence of these comments suggests the task definition is not fully finalized or is referencing a state that no longer exists, creating ambiguity in the task description.

Tasks T042-T050 (Data Streaming Implementation) are listed in the 'Notes' section but are not integrated into the Phase structure or dependency graph. They lack a clear phase assignment (e.g., Foundational or Polish) and dependency links to the main pipeline tasks (T005, T006), making their execution order and coverage of the 'CPU-only/6h' constraint (SC-001) ambiguous.
